-- script --
start /home/evan
size 60 14
note ranked: the best fit comes first, not the first in the alphabet
type re
snapshot re
state current readme.md
note a capital makes the match exact
press ctrl+u
type RE
snapshot RE
state current README.txt
note a glob
press ctrl+u
type *.png
snapshot glob
state rows 3
note an extension reaches the hidden too
press ctrl+u
type .pro
snapshot dot
state current .profile
note no match
press ctrl+u
type zzz
snapshot none
state rows 0
note backspace widens again
press backspace backspace backspace
state rows 9
